steps.title: Define Project Metadata
steps.description: Configure core app metadata, specifying the application name 'Tu Kon Hai Bhai' and package ID 'com.tukonhaibhai.app'.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Settings
steps.description: Create build.gradle incorporating AGP 8.3.2, compile SDK 34, target SDK 34, and pure Java 1.8 compatibility options.

steps.title: Design Android Manifest
steps.description: Create the application manifest configuration defining activities, launcher intents, correct namespaces, and Material Light themes.

steps.title: Build Main UI Layout
steps.description: Draft the visual interface inside activity_main.xml containing stylized text components and functional interaction buttons.

steps.title: Initialize Main Activity Controller
steps.description: Establish the main class MainActivity.java, binding screen layout variables, views, and setting basic lifecycle hooks.

steps.title: Integrate Random Phrase Generator
steps.description: Program translation variants of 'tu kon hai bhai' with random indices for dynamic user experience.

steps.title: Incorporate Adaptive Color Shifting
steps.description: Implement background color interpolation that randomly alters the theme to match the light-hearted tone.

steps.title: Program Dynamic Alpha Animations
steps.description: Implement fading animations during the phrase transitions to offer fluid, appealing visual feedback.

steps.title: Add Content Sharing Operations
steps.description: Integrate system Intents enabling users to share the selected phrases with friends instantly.

steps.title: Program Interaction Feedback
steps.description: Configure click listeners, Toast messages, and long-click actions across the primary title layout.

steps.title: Building Tu Kon Hai Bhai
steps.description: Execute Gradle build toolchain actions to compile, bundle resources, and output the final installable APK package.
